sections.name: Capability modules
sections.description: The she-runs-the-whole-thing stack: six alternating function rows (strategy, search, lifecycle, paid, social, insights), each an italic operator-pain quote, a first-person Alfred claim, a mechanism sentence naming real tools, an adoption-count proof line in mono, and a token-built mini visual (brief, trend, queue, shift, answer). The copy formula is the pattern.

usedBy.note: 'She runs the whole thing' six-module rows: pain quote (shipped but CSS-hidden) + color channel label + benefit h3 + tool-naming mechanism + adoption-count proof

props.name: modules
props.type: Array<{label, pain, title, body, proof, visual}>
props.doc: visual.kind is one of brief | trend | queue | shift | answer; each kind is a token-built mini card

props.name: showPain
props.doc: render the italic operator-pain quote above each module (enrichlabs ships it hidden; we show it by default)

sections.name: Team roster
sections.description: Meet-your-new-team roster of the four Alfred module personas (Marketing live today, Sales and Receivables on waitlist, Core included): initial-tile avatars built from tokens, role line, one-liner, status badge and a learn-more link. The one live module's tile carries the section's single gradient element.

usedBy.note: 'Meet your new marketing team' 2x2 agent-persona cards (Helena/Sam/Kai/Angela) sold like hires, whole card the link

props.name: members
props.type: Array<{initial, name, role, line, status, live?}>
props.doc: live: true highlights the card (gradient tile, focus border, brand badge)

props.name: layout
props.doc: 2x2 grid at 880px, or four across full width

sections.name: Tuned by you
sections.description: Built-by-operators-tuned-by-you intelligence grid: four claims (playbooks not guesses, your brand learned, sharper every week, compounding value) with line icons; the self-improving card carries the 82-to-96-percent acceptance curve as a mono evidence line.

usedBy.note: 'Built by marketers. Tuned by you.' intelligence rail: by-marketers playbooks / brand learned / self-improving 82-97% / value compounds

props.name: items
props.doc: icon is one of playbook | brand | improve | compound

sections.name: Time-back callout
sections.description: The reclaimed-hours interstitial: a setup line, one poster-scale figure (the section's one poster statement, set in the poster face so Clash survives marketing dark), and a qualifier that restates the enemy: hiring, managing and chasing overhead. Quiet band by default.

usedBy.note: big-stat band: 'Get back up to' + 140px animated hours figure + qualifier restating freelancers as the enemy

props.name: footnote
props.doc: mono evidence line under the caption; empty string hides it

sections.name: Operator quotes
sections.description: Testimonial wall in the pre-highlighted register: five operator quotes, each with exactly one semibold money phrase (the disciplined stand-in for emoji and caps), name, role and fictional company. Featured layout leads with one full-width quote over a two-by-two grid.

usedBy.note: 'What marketers are saying' wall: selective <strong> bolding pre-highlights the money phrase inside each quote

props.name: quotes
props.doc: strong is a substring of quote rendered semibold in text-primary

props.name: featured
props.doc: true: first quote spans full width; false: two-column masonry

sections.name: Trial FAQ
sections.description: The conversational nine-question FAQ, objection first: the general-AI-assistant question opens, then reporting cadence, results timeline, usage metering, privacy and no-training, integrations, brand learning, trial terms, and the bench teaser closes. Alfred answers every one in first person, numbers attached.

usedBy.note: 'Good to know.' accordion: killer objection ('Can't I just use ChatGPT?') first, answers dense with numbers, specialists teaser as the final answer

sections.name: Specialists callout
sections.description: The more-agents teaser: a brief band naming the waitlist modules (Alfred for Sales, Alfred for Receivables) as chips, one line on the shared memory, and a book-a-demo CTA. Split variant puts the CTAs in a card column beside the copy.

usedBy.note: the specialists FAQ answer naming Sam/Paul/Angela/Kai and closing 'Book a demo and we will design the bench around your stack', promoted to its own band

sections.name: Work-with CTA
sections.description: The minimal centered close: availability eyebrow, a question headline addressed to the reader ('Ready to work with Alfred?'), the trial terms restated once more, and a single primary CTA. Nothing else survives to the last section. Glow variant adds the brand glow background.

usedBy.note: 'Ready to work with Helena?' buy band: 'Available now' eyebrow, terms line repeated a third time, only the primary CTA survives

props.name: glow
props.doc: adds the periwinkle and orange page glows behind the close
